decision_rule_fixed_here: SAME-FLIGHT PERCEPTION TEMPLATE COLUMN READ (NX programme round R6-P1; owner decisions 245-248; instrument E1/E2 at the Perception node; claim ceiling 'nominated'; a MEASUREMENT cell that claims no benefit). One flight, one Perception visit per row, five arms over the SAME QueryState and evidence: p1 (E= presence tag), p2 (E= tag + up to three M= heard mentions), p3 (E= tag with an unsure hedge + mentions), aa (the twin, replicate_of lock) and lock (the locked template, delivering, last); each non-delivering arm is followed by its own first-visit Solver contact (the LOCKED Solver template) over its own note. THE READS, all from this one flight's sealed columns, model-free (scripts/analysis/nx_r6_read.sh): (1) NODE-LOCAL (reader E2b, scripts/analysis/slurp_nx_perception_column_read.py, tag grammar configs/probes/nx/perception/r6/TAG-GRAMMAR-v1.md, p3 read with --tag-set p3=none,some,unsure): per arm, on the rank-1 candidate and on the list majority, the parse classes (ok / absent / invalid), E=none AUC / precision / recall against empty gold, E=some precision / recall against non-empty gold, the unsure rate by gold class, heard-mention containment (share of gold entities whose normalised surface equals an offered M= surface, per slot type) and option precision; the paired intent guards against lock (gold on list, rank-1 share, candidate count, prompt tokens, note parse status); whole-utterance cluster bootstrap CI95, 10,000 draws, seed 20260915. (2) INFORMATION GAIN and the GATE ESTIMATE per candidate arm (scripts/analysis/slurp_nx_r6_upstream_empty.py --verdict-source perception-arm:<arm> --gain-baseline {n1,n1+prior,n1+prior+lock}): the cross-fitted AUC increment of the rank-1 E=none verdict over the baseline for 'gold empty' with a whole-utterance cluster bootstrap CI95 (2,000 draws, seed 20261010), and the delivered-metric estimate of the c3verdict-style gate (verdict E=none AND N1 >= 0.2, plus the fixed N1 grid) on the lock Solver column of the v4g base (10,000 draws, seed 20260915): pp with CI95, false fills removed, non-empty exact lost, intent rows moved. (3) LOCKED-CONSUMER read: each arm's own level-2 Solver column against lock's (the E2 Solver reader inside the node-local pass, and the official pooled SLU-F1 of each column scored once with slurp-slu-official-train and read paired per row). (4) THE TWIN NULL: aa minus lock on every metric, read first. ACCEPTANCE (design sections 2.2 and 4, decision 247): NODE-LOCAL acceptance of an arm = rank-1 E=none recall >= 0.80 and precision >= 0.75 on empty-gold rows, with a rank-1 tag parse rate (ok) >= 0.90 (below that the arm is reported as a FORM FAILURE, not a verdict), and no intent guard moving by more than the twin's own movement plus 0.65 pp; INFORMATION GAIN = the CI95 lower bound of the cross-fitted AUC increment over {N1, intent prior} above zero (additional) -- stability (the same sign and CI-LB > 0 on TRAIN Fold A with the rule fixed on Fold B) is R6-A's term, not this cell's; the delivered-metric estimate is reported through the measured exchange rates (+0.033 pp per false fill removed, -0.070 pp per non-empty exact row lost), with intent rows moved = 0. NOTHING IS LOCKED HERE: this is a selection read on the selection roster. PLATEAU RULE: two evaluated Perception-entity rounds without an arm clearing node-local acceptance close the node; the next lever is then the v2 note contract (decision 248) or the supply-side presence prior, in that order.

failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. AT MOST ONE root-diagnosed recovery re-registration; a second failure closes the cell and the fix is proven on a four-row dry run. The budget is run-cumulative across attempts.
one_factor: the Perception instruction template (phase_material.perception.instruction_template) of each non-delivering arm: ONE hash-pinned path per arm under probes/nx/perception/r6/, nothing else (no supply knob, decoding, response format or tool authority; the distinction channel of the registered slurp-intent-hypotheses-v1 note is the only free channel); the base, the Fold B pins, the review-off program and the module block are the instrument's carrier, shared by every arm; each non-delivering arm's level-2 Solver contact renders the LOCKED Solver template over that arm's own note
prohibitions: No test-split, DEV or Fold A contact or read (Fold A confirms only a later R6-A column, under its own registration).
No second factor: one axis (the Perception instruction template), none on aa or lock.
No tool schema on any role; no Reviewer or Planner visit; max_revisions 0.
No change of the Perception response format or note schema (slurp-intent-hypotheses-v1 stays; a v2 contract is decision 248's conditional engineering).
No Perception verdict is delivered: the delivering arm is the locked path (invariant I7); the gate estimate is an OFFLINE read, not a wired component.
No flight before root countersigns the DRAFT rows, mints the decision receipt and the cells are flipped.
No arm column is opened before the READ row is root countersigned.
No system-level claim: a column effect may only nominate, and this cell claims no benefit.
